name: Object Tracking (identity across frames)
purpose: Associate per-frame object detections (the detect.objects #16 output shape: each detection {class, class_id, score, box{x,y,width,height}}) into stable identity tracks so the same object keeps ONE track_id across a sequence of frames. A DETERMINISTIC, PURE frame-by-frame greedy IoU matcher, PER-CLASS: candidate (track,detection) pairs with IoU >= -IouThreshold are resolved by a total order (IoU descending, tie-broken by detection order then track_id); matched tracks are extended, unmatched detections BIRTH a new monotonic track_id (in detection order), unmatched tracks COAST with a constant-position predictor up to -MaxAge frames then DIE (a later detection births a new id). No model, no CUDA, no loopback port, no randomness -> CPU-only, parallel_safe:true, byte-identical for identical input. The second module of the Phase C video spine (architectural position 20), following media.decompose #32 (position 19). MVP is decoupled from live detection: it reads detections from a JSON file or inline -InputsJson.frames (live composition of #32 keyframes -> #16 -> track.objects is a named follow-on).

invocation.args_spec: Named params -InputFile <path> (JSON detection sequence; required unless InputsJson supplies input/frames); -IouThreshold <0..1> (default 0.3); -MaxAge <int >=0> (coast frames before death, default 2); -MinScore <double >=0> (drop detections scored below this, default 0 = keep all); -Classes <name,...> (only track these classes). OR -InputsJson '<json {input, frames, iou_threshold, max_age, min_score, classes}>' where 'frames' is an inline detection sequence (an alternative to a file). Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path to a JSON detection sequence. Accepted shapes: a bare array of frames, {frames:[...]}, {sequence:[...]}, or a single detect.objects result ({detections:[...]}) treated as one frame. Each frame is either a bare array of detections or {frame|index, timestamp_s|timestamp, detections:[...]}. Required unless InputsJson provides 'input' or inline 'frames'.

inputs.name: frames
inputs.description: Inline detection sequence (an alternative to a file), passed via -InputsJson. Same per-frame shape as a file's frames.

inputs.name: iou_threshold
inputs.description: Minimum IoU (0..1) between a track's last box and a detection's box for them to be considered a match.

inputs.name: max_age
inputs.description: Maximum number of consecutive missed frames a track may coast (constant-position) before it dies. 0 disables coasting (a single gap ends the track).

inputs.name: min_score
inputs.description: Drop detections whose score is present and below this floor before association. 0 keeps everything.

inputs.name: classes
inputs.description: Optional class-name filter (e.g. [person, car]); only detections of these classes are tracked. Matching is always per-class regardless of this filter.

outputs.description: { input{source,path,frames}, params{iou_threshold,max_age,min_score,classes}, summary{input_frames,input_detections,tracked_detections,track_count,births,deaths,coast_frames,max_concurrent_tracks,class_summary{class:count}}, tracks[{track_id,class,class_id,frames[{frame,timestamp_s,box{x,y,width,height},score,det_index}],first_frame,last_frame,length,aged_out}] } ordered by track_id. The tracks.json artifact carries the same payload minus volatile fields, so it is byte-identical for identical input.
